Le gouvernement chinois a ordonné à plus: The Chinese government has ordered several government agencies to drop Windows 10 China Government Edition in favor of national Linux distributions. The end-of-life date for this specialized version, initially scheduled for February 2027, has been brought forward to 2026 in the name of digital sovereignty and data security.
Pékin a ordonné à certaines agences état: Beijing has ordered certain state agencies to abandon Windows 10 China Government Edition in favor of local open-source alternatives. The result of a 2016 joint venture between Microsoft and state-owned group CETC, this version was set to be discontinued in February 2027, but its withdrawal has been brought forward to 2026 due to security and digital sovereignty imperatives.
Microsoft n'a pas connaissance d'un inci: Microsoft is not aware of any security incident affecting this product, which continues to receive regular updates.
Les distributions souveraines Kylin OS (: The sovereign distributions Kylin OS (developed by Kylin Software) and UOS (developed by UnionTech and derived from Deepin/Debian) are positioning themselves as the major replacements for Windows. Following the announcement of this directive, their stock prices rose sharply. Meanwhile, Huawei's HarmonyOS is preparing a PC version, although only the Kylin and UOS solutions are currently mature enough for the public sector.
La migration vers Linux implique un chan: Migrating to Linux involves a major technical undertaking for the administration: validation of drivers and peripherals, overhaul of Windows-dependent business software, identity management, and staff training. While this transition does not immediately affect all consumer PCs running Windows 11 Home China, the strategic shift toward a 100% Linux institutional workstation is now irreversible.
Bien que l'ampleur exacte du déploiement: Although the exact scale of the deployment remains gradual, the trajectory is confirmed: the future of Chinese administrative workstations will rely on the Linux ecosystem.
